balls.text: slower yet again and the batsman has done exactly what Steyn had done off the previous ball, except that it went higher in the air and was caught by Rohit Sharma at mid-off.
slower one and totally deceived by it, scoops it back to Malinga. End of a torturous stay at the pitch.
short, bouncer and left alone by Steyn. He will keep that in mind, will Steyn.
yorker length from Malinga, tapped to the off side for a single
takes it on the full by moving to the off stump and hits it through the leg side, they take one, want to go for the second and rush off for it.
outside the off stump, on a length, tapped to the off side for a single
down the leg-side and Duminy tries to pull it away, misses and it is a wide.
outside the off stump, bounce and his cut misses the ball by some distance.
outside the off-stump, gets an outside edge and goes fine to third-man for a four.
run-out appeal! Third umpire review and he is just in. Tried to dab it to the off side and run away, but Sharma was quick to it and hits it direct.
appeal for a caught behind and given not-out. There was some noise alright, but cannot be sure it was out, outside the off-stump and did it miss the edge?
slower one, good length and Mishra has spooned it to mid-off for a dolly! That is poor batting, especially when you have a batsman of note at the other end.
pitched up to the batsman, outside the off stump and driven through the covers for a single.
finally one pitched up and slashed over the covers, but for a single
again short of length and pushes Mishra to the back foot and he defends.
short of length, outside the off-stump and Mishra fails to get his bat to it.
pitched up, outside the off stump and driven to mid-on and they get a single
pitched right up and Mishra defends on the back-foot.
short of length, bounce, pace and a tad bit of movement, beats the outside edge of the bat and the keeper collects it.
short of length again, tapped to third-man for a single
outside the off stump and he tries to cut it away, gets a bottom edge and goes over the wicket-keeper for a four.
slower one, goes for a big one, can only spoon it up high in the air and Rohit Sharma takes an excellent catch running back from point.
outside the off-stump, punched but straight to point
outside the off stump, goes for a big heave and takes an outside edge to third-man for a single
outside the off stump, punched to short cover and Peterson dives to his left and fields it well.
on the pads, with no pace on it, he easily flicks it away to the left of fine-leg for a couple of runs.
length, outside the off stump and knocked to long-on for a single
slower one, right up to the batsman and that is fielded well to his left by the bowler.
pulled away, short ball and that goes into the gap at deep square-leg for a four!
goes down the pitch and has smacked it over the bowler's head for a six! Some respite.
The South African gets one flighted up by his countryman and he drives to long-on for a single
outside the off stump and driven to long-off for a single
on the middle stump, the length pulled up a little, across the line and missed.
and we repeat, pitched up yet again, driven back to the bowler.
pitched up and driven back to the bowler.

short ball and that has been top-edged to Harbhajan Singh. Chipli was looking to pull it away but was surprised by the bounce probably and easy catch. They checked for the no-ball but nothing to worry for the fielding time and it is all sixes at 66/6.
outside the off-stump, driven to the point region for a single
short of good length, goes on the back foot and defended.
on the front foot, defended and rushed off for a quick single.
defended on the front foot, back to the bowler
cut and caught! That was a rasping stroke, went hard at Rohit Sharma at point, who picks it up easily, I think he made it look easy much like Mark Waugh would in the slips!
quicker, going down the leg stump and he is on the back foot, misses playing it through the on-side.
shorter this time, on the back foot and punched through the covers for a single
outside the off stump, on the front foot and dabbed to the leg side.
on the middle stump, defended on the front foot.
outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and that has gone through the slips for a four.
gone, stumped! This was going straight on, Dhawan went down the pitch, missed it and it sneaked through, Karthik collected well and easily removed the bails.
dabbed away to the point fielder, Rohit Sharma for a single.
swept away and that has gone away to the fence! It was a slower one and the bowler was treated like a spinner.
slows it down, short of length and tries to cut it away, but goes hard into the ground.
outside the off stump but pitched right up to the bat yet again, driven away for a single to the sweeper
again pitched up and Dhawan drives it to long-on for a single
pitched up to the batsman, driven to the long-on region for a single
short and lot of bounce on that one! He tried to cut it away it but missed it because of the bounce.
on his pads, goes down the pitch but misses
shorter this time and punched through the covers for a single
outside the off-stump and cut it away, single to Sachin Tendulkar at point
goes down the pitch and Harbhajan tosses that one up and on to his legs, driven to long-on
slower from Harbhajan, taps it to the off side, the non-striker wanted a single but refused by the batsman.
slower, outside the off stump and driven to the wide mid-off region, a bit of a misfield by Munaf Patel and they get a second.
length ball, pushed on the off side and they get a single
slower ball, pitched up to the bat, defended on the front foot.
bouncer, quick, 139.8 km/hr and he ducks under the delivery.
short once again and this was climbing, there is a lot of bounce here if I did not say that before. Down the leg side and a wide.
short ball, and Duminy takes evasive action, lets it go.

straight to the man at third-man, caught! After one good innings, tonight's captain White's been dismissed for a duck, bouncer and he tries to slash it away to third-man and he is caught. The bounce got a bit big on him.
down the leg side, quick but wide and called by the umpire.
wanted to go down the track, bowled it shorter and that is pushed back to the bowler.
goes down the track, gets an inside edge for a couple of runs.
slower, brings him out, and defended on the front foot
tries to sweep it away, misses

goes for a slog and would you believe it, Harbhajan Singh has taken his second wicket of the tournament! Jaggi went for a sweep, the ball did not turn and took the top-edge and went to the mid-off fielder, who catches it behind his head
short and I saw some turn, cut away to the sweeper for a single.
short one, pulled away, but does not get the middle of the bat and it goes to the mid-on region.
dropped at short cover! Outside the off stump, driven to Peterson to his right, he dives and gets his palm to it, but it pops out.
pitched right up and driven back to the bowler.
good length, outside the off stump and played away to third-man for a single
good length ball, gets an outside the edge to point where the fielder dives, but fails to prevent the single.
on the middle, pitched up and leading edge to short point.
beaten by the bounce, tries to cut it away but it was too quick and high for Dhawan. Only 2 off the over

pitched right up, rasping drive through the off-side but straight to Harbhajan at extra-cover, Dhawan had taken too many steps down before realising that there was no single there. Harbhajan throws it back to the striker's end and misses!
bounce and pace, hits Jaggi on his gloves and he looked ruffled before Dhawan calls him away for a single
chipped in the air and it is straight to Munaf at mid-on! It did not seem like it was a very quick ball, checked his stroke but went to the fielder, Munaf had to bend down low to take that.
goes down the pitch and drives it to mid-on, it was well-timed but not too well-placed
outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and driven through to third-man for a single
short this one, quicker too, opens the face of the ball, guided to the third-man region for a single
slower one again, again into his stroke quite early and the end result is a drive straight back that hits the stumps at the non-striker's end.
length ball, but slower and the batsman was way too early into his stroke, falls just short of short point.
slower one, dabbed to the off side and they get a single more comfortably this time
length ball, defended to point and they are off! Patel responded too and had that hit, the batsman was three yards away from the crease!
outside the off-stump, pitched up and Shikhar Dhawan guides it through the slips for four! So Munaf and RP had a clutch of slips, Malinga does not.
on his pads yet again and he flicks it to the leg side but straight to short mid-wicket.
pitched right up and driven to mid-off for a single
drifts on to his pads yet again and he plays it round the corner, it is Lasith Malinga at fine-leg and they run well for their second run.
outside the off-stump, gets an outside edge and flies to point on the bounce
down the leg-side now and he nudges it to the region between fine-leg and deep square-leg and they come back for the second
driven on the up and that will go through to the long-off fence. He pitched it up and he covered for the swing too.
outside the off-stump, swings after it passes the bat and Dinesh Karthik misses it, they get a bye.
defended on the leg-side, wanted a single but went to the bowler.
and some verve from Patel, goes down the track and tries to swing it away, gets an inside-edge to deep square-leg
short of good length, punched to the covers. He, as expected, is getting some bounce too.
driven through the leg-side and that will go through square-leg for a four. Bit of an inside edge I think
tries to work through the leg-side, gets a leading edge and it goes over the cover fielder. The ball is flying all over...
pitched up yet again and Patel opens the face of the bat, guides it to the third-man region for a single.
pitched up and he goes for a slash, he does not get any bat on it.
pace, bounce, swing, what else do you want! Gave some width for Parthiv to attempt that cut but he misses.
tries to pull him away and that has gone away for a six! There is much pace here and Parthiv is trying to take advantage of it.
length ball and one Patel was hurried into his shot and the other Patel at mid-on was hurried into chasing the ball. A couple for the batsman.
outside the off stump and swings away, lot of bounce too! Why did Harbhajan bowl the first over again?
goes down the pitch and Harbhajan fires it down the leg-side, hits his pad and rolls to the off side.
pitched up to the bat and defended back to the bowler.
tries to sweep it away, hits the pad and there is another appeal, hitting outside the line, goes to short third-man
short, hint of turn away, punched to mid-off
going down the leg-side, no spin there for Harbhajan Singh, hits the pads and stifled appeal.
short of a length and Patel cuts it away for a couple.
slower one, pitched right up and that is driven through the covers. The field was up and it is hit through for three and that is the end of the game!
bouncer and called a wide by the umpire, over the batsman's head
googly, well read and played away to the off side for a single
short and that has been cut away to the fence for a four, this is already the most expensive over of the game. Disappointing stuff.
quick ball, down the leg-side and it is a wide, they run off it as well. Mishra's poor match continues.
on the stumps, defended back to the bowler.
played away to the off side and they have run away for a single
full-toss and thwacked through wide long-on for four!
down the track and driven through the covers, almost goes to the fence, but JP Duminy at long off, runs to wide to his left and saves it
slower ball, well bowled, outside the off stump and beats him for pace. Off the back of the hand and the batsman was early in his shot.
pitched right up to the batsman and he has been played through the covers for a single
good length, and he flicks it away to the leg side for his first run now.
on a length, defended on the back foot and it goes to the short mid-wicket fielder
good length, outside the off stump, driven on the up and to the point fielder.
bouncer, gone! It was a quick one, Franklin went for a pull shot, gets a glove en route the wicket-keeper. Five down now!
pitched right up and driven back to the bowler.
close, could have been a run-out had the mid-off fielder picked it well, pitched up, driven to the fielder and there was some confusion.
pitched right up to the bat and that is tapped away to point for a single
outside the off stump, I think it was an attempted googly, tries to cut it away, goes straight to point
full-toss and that driven to long-off for a single
pitched right up to the bat and easily played down the ground, to long-on, for a single
short ball and this is dabbed away to the third-man region for a single
on the middle stump, defended away to the off side.
pitched right up, driven to mid-on but he is really close to the bat and they take no run
outside the off stump and Rayadu leaves the ball alone. Still enough in the pitch to test the batsmen.
outside the off stump, length ball and cut away to the sweeper for a single
bouncer, good ball and Franklin sways away and leaves it alone.

gone, caught, thrown it away! Goes down the track for some reason, when they needed only at less than five runs an over, and wants to go for the big one, misses hitting the middle of the bat and loops up a simple catch between mid-off and mid-on
short, outside the off-stump and cut away to the fence.
goes down the pitch and drives it to long-on for a single.
comes down the track, drives to long-on
outside the off stump, a bit of deviation in air, driven to sweeper
on the front foot, driven to long-off for a single
opens the face of the bat and Sharma plays it down to the third-man region for a single. End of what has easily been one of the best spells in this format of the game.
dropped! Simple catch, in his hands, and then pops out. Franklin upper cut it to Mishra at third-man and he should have caught that.
144.2 km/hr, pitched up well, but down the leg stump, flicked away to the fine-leg fielder for a single
good length, outside the off stump, edged away to the third-man region for a single.
outside the off stump, punched to the off side and the short point fields again
on the off-stump, pitched up and driven to short point.
pitched right up, driven to the bowler and that is the end of an over that costs six
plonked his foot ahead, then waited for the ball before driving it straight
shorter, played away to deep square-leg again and they are off for a single
googly from Mishra, tapped gently to the leg side and before the deep square-leg fielder can come in, they are back for a second
taken on the full, paddle swept it to deep fine-leg for a couple
pitched right up by Mishra and that is driven to long-off for a single
pitched up outside the off stump, punched but straight to the fielder.
another one pitched up this time, driven to long-off for a single
opens the face of the bat to a rather wide ball outside the off-stump and it misses the point fielder and goes through to the fence for a four.
outside the off stump, pitched right up, the batsman tried to glide it down but misses, the bowler appealed for a caught-behind, the batsman for a wide.
cut away, but that is well fielded by Duminy at point, flinging himself to his right. He has been excellent in that region
pitched up, outside the off stump and driven on the up. Straight to the short cover fielder.
outside the off stump and Sharma manages to drive it to long-on for a single
pitched right up to the bat, driven to long-on for a single
leggie, pitched probably on the leg stump and hits the pad, appeal but given not out.
cuts it away to the deep point region for a single
too short from Mishra and that is pulled away to the mid-wicket region, they run two as the fielder there, Reddy, dives and saves the boundary
pitched right up to the bat, cut away, straight to point.
pitched up, one of the rare ones this over, Franklin comes on to the front foot, defends.
on the length this time, middle stump, defended back to the bowler.
another wide, this was quick again but directionless. Down the leg side.
quick ball, short of good length, defended on the back foot, back to the bowler.
short, 150 km/hr, really fast, down the leg side and he tries to pull it away, misses it and wide called. Nine balls still to go from Steyn!

gone, out, it was not a short ball! Kartik's foot was going nowhere, he remained glued to the crease, takes the outside edge and he is caught behind. Three down with nine deliveries from Steyn still to come.
god length, quick and Sharma tries to drive it through point, Duminy fields it well at point, else it was going to the fence.
good length, edges and this seems to be Rohit's night, it falls short of the slip.
on the off-stump, tapped it away to the off side for no run
inside edge, again survives, takes a single off that
defended on the front foot, off a ball on the good length.
finally, finally, bad ball, but it needed to be taken advantage of, it was too short and Sharma was waiting, pulled it away for a six.
good length ball, on the up, tries to drive it, gets an inside edge and there is a single
short of length, defended on the back foot and rushed off for a single
driven through the covers for a single
cuts it in half. Sharma looks puzzled, but I am puzzled because he has not yet got out. Goes through the bat and pad and misses the stumps.
pitched up to the bat and Sharma goes for a rather expansive drive. Missed. On a normal pitch, this shot was probably on.
outside the off stump, pitched full and driven through the covers for a single
good length and defended it back to the bowler.
pitched right up and driven back past the bowler, a single only though
down the leg side yet again and Sharma does not get any bat on it, called a wide.
outside the off stump, Karthik tries to drive through the line as if batting on 256. He isn't obviously, misses and it goes through to the wicket-keeper.
edged and taken! That was outside the off stump, Tendulkar wanted to cut it away, but gets it off the edge and it goes through to the lone slip in place, match on?
short from the bowler, pulled easily by Tendulkar and it goes away to Chipli at backward square-leg. Saves the boundary.
goes down the track and gets an outside edge to the third-man region for a single
inside edge off a delivery that jags back into the bat, goes to short fine-leg
pitched right up, Tendulkar wanted to drive, did not get off the middle and the ball landed right in front of him after the inside edge. A single thanks to some superb running by Sharma.
pitched outside, moving a little away and that is left alone by the batsman, finally he has begun to leave those outside the off stump.
tries to hit on the up, gets an outside edge through to third-man
this is close to the stumps but left well by Tendulkar
shot, bullet, mid-off, misfield, four! That was a half volley, Tendulkar had enough of the swinging ball, he launches at it and a bit of a misfield gets him four.
on the pads yet again, and this time he flicks away this good length ball to the left of deep square-leg for a couple
down the leg side and swinging further away from the bat, wide called.
pitched right up, defended by Tendulkar back to the bowler.
good length and that zips through, 135.6 km/hr, beats Sharma, hits pads and goes through to the wicket-keeper.
short ball, Sharma has controlled the pull well, rolls the wrist well, there was no fine-leg in place.
good length, played out on the leg side, next to the pitch and they are off for a single. Runs at a premium.
he has padded up and there was no appeal to that one! Whoa, it thumped above the pads after jagging back!
short of length this time, tapped away to the leg side for a single
on his pads and that is timed beautifully, but almost to the hands of the mid-on, Jaggi, on his right. Went for the catch and it just eluded him, goes to the fence.
finally a sensible stroke from Sharma, defended on the front foot and played to covers, gets a single.
yes we do! Outside the off-stump and Sharma lets that go, this, to be fair was too far wide.
good length, outside the off stump and leaves it again. That is two in a row. Will we have a hat-trick? Of leaves.
outside the off stump and surprise, surprise, Sharma has left that one alone.
length ball, and Sharma has a waft at it, and the story of the night continues. Misses it.
On the middle stump and swinging away, gets an outside edge, and in the air! Almost goes to the gully in place, to go with the two slips.

over the top and that is dropped. Cameron White has floored a half-chance, at short cover. Sharma tried to drive it on the up, did not get it off the middle and it should have been pouched, instead it goes over him.
on his pads, manages to flick it away to mid-wicket but straight to the fielder.
pitched up and driven to the short cover fielder.
comes up to the front foot and delicately caressed away through mid-wicket for a four...no wait, that us pulled up really well by Jaggi and restricts it to three.
outside the off stump, left alone by the batsman. Not too much swing for VP Singh.
way down the leg-side and that is the second run of the innings, incidentally, also the second wide.
outside the off-stump, bounces and jumps up, Tendulkar lets it go.
and this time it is outside the off stump, and swinging away yet again, Rohit wanted to have a flash at it, but he missed it by a mile.
what-an-over-so-far! This is fast, 140 km/hr, pitching on middle, going away like a banana skin!
cut away and beaten yet again! This is fast bowling of the best order, and Sharma is doing his best to stay alive to the occasion.
pitched outside the off stump, swinging away and beating the batsman. No-one else is yawning. Not the batsman for sure.
on the stumps, quick, 143.1 km/hr and driven to mid-off for nothing.
down the leg side and Sharma fails to get a tickle there, wide called
bowled him! first ball! Beaten totally for pace, jaffa! It has sneaked through the batsman and he did not have any time to put his bat down, timber!
